source_policy: Official provider resources only; no live accounts or paid jobs.

rows.name: Volcengine Machine Learning Platform
rows.training_mode: Custom notebook, single-node and distributed model training
rows.accelerator: GPU/CPU cloud resources; RDMA-capable GPU options
rows.free_offer: No general free training allowance verified
rows.offer_notes: Enterprise account setup and GPU resource purchase are documented. Free signup or proof-of-concept access does not establish a compute grant.
rows.interface: Console and CLI training jobs, TensorBoard, container images and object storage
rows.limits: Enterprise verification, account quotas, exact accelerator, regional access, billing controls and portable export require qualification.

rows.name: SenseCore
rows.training_mode: Custom container training jobs across GPU worker pods
rows.free_offer: No general free training allocation verified
rows.offer_notes: Research-qualified through official job CLI, not merely corporate model-training claims. Commercial access and exact pricing require account qualification.
rows.interface: SCO CLI creates, describes, logs, stops and deletes training jobs
rows.limits: Workspace/queue permission, purchased allocation, exact GPU compatibility, checkpoint storage and output downloads must be tested.

rows.name: UCloud GPU Cloud / UAI Train
rows.training_mode: Custom GPU VM/container training, single-node and distributed jobs
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA GPU VMs and bare metal; configuration dependent
rows.free_offer: No quantified generally available free GPU allowance verified
rows.offer_notes: Official GPU product advertises tailored trials without published entitlement. Treat as paid or sales-approved trial, not automatic free compute.
rows.interface: GPU VM SSH/images; UAI Train container jobs and native cloud interfaces
rows.limits: Resource and bandwidth/storage costs, trial scope, account verification, quotas, interruption behavior and portable export require testing.

rows.name: Kingsoft Cloud Xingliu Platform
rows.training_mode: Custom PyTorch/TensorFlow container jobs and distributed model training
rows.accelerator: GPU resource groups and optional heterogeneous CPU/NPU pools
rows.free_offer: No general free training allowance verified
rows.offer_notes: Current June/September 2026 guides explicitly purchase GPU resources, create queues and launch Llama/PyTorch training; this is paid execution.
rows.interface: Training console, containers, TensorBoard, KS3 storage and native lifecycle interfaces
rows.limits: Resource groups/queues, VPC, storage credentials, exact accelerator, costs, usable model export and automation contract require qualification.

rows.name: Bohrium Scientific Computing
rows.training_mode: Containerized scientific model training and custom compute commands
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA T4, V100 or A100 in documented training examples
rows.free_offer: No current general free training credit verified
rows.offer_notes: Scientific research tutorials are free resources; compute requires top-up/project configuration. Do not confuse Bohrium AI-assistant credits with GPU training credits.
rows.interface: bohr CLI submits, monitors, terminates and downloads job results
rows.limits: Account/project budget, actual machine catalog, training framework compatibility, data transfer and regional availability require qualification.

rows.name: Featurize
rows.training_mode: Custom deep-learning experiments and notebook training
rows.accelerator: NVIDIA RTX 3090, RTX 4090 and RTX PRO 6000 offerings
rows.free_offer: Purchase-conditioned promotion: first top-up of at least ¥5 receives a one-hour experience voucher
rows.offer_notes: Paid usage or monthly rental. Free disk allowances and unspecified activity rewards are not general free GPU compute.
rows.interface: Hosted laboratory/notebooks and documented instance rental; automated lifecycle not qualified
rows.limits: Voucher GPU eligibility/expiry, storage cleanup, current price, actual quota, cancellation and local model retrieval require testing.

rows.name: AutoDL
rows.training_mode: Custom Python training through GPU containers, JupyterLab and SSH
rows.accelerator: Multiple NVIDIA GPU models; selected non-CUDA accelerators need separate framework qualification
rows.free_offer: No universal free compute verified; application-selected 2026 academic funding program exists
rows.offer_notes: Academic program targets scholars at Chinese universities/research institutes. Grants are research funding, not a universal signup balance.
rows.interface: JupyterLab, SSH, instance API and documented data upload/download
rows.limits: Compute billed while running. Storage can incur separate charges; stopped instance retention and long inactivity cleanup require external checkpoint backups.

rows.name: Gitee AI / MoArk
rows.training_mode: Managed text/image model fine-tuning and LoRA
rows.accelerator: Domestic GPU training; Iluvatar and MetaX listed
rows.free_offer: No verified general free training allowance
rows.offer_notes: Actual training is documented separately from model API inference. Fine-tuning bills by elapsed time; API credits must not be assumed applicable.
rows.interface: Managed training UI, progress/loss tracking and model repository
rows.limits: Supported base models, training API automation, portable weights, checkpoint resume and accelerator-specific compatibility require qualification.

rows.name: SiliconFlow
rows.training_mode: Advertised managed model fine-tuning using uploaded datasets
rows.accelerator: Managed GPU resources; training hardware unspecified
rows.offer_notes: Official product page describes dataset upload, training launch, metrics and deployment. Public execution/export contract remains less detailed than established job platforms.
rows.interface: Advertised UI/API fine-tuning workflow; account-level capability verification required
rows.limits: Supported models, actual training availability, pricing, weight download, checkpoint recovery and arbitrary-script support unverified.

watchlist.name: JD Cloud
watchlist.reason: Official legacy private-cloud GPU whitepaper found; current public training execution and commercial access documentation not sufficiently verified.

watchlist.name: AutoAI
watchlist.reason: autoai.com resolves to WeCloud/NavInfo identity; no verified general GPU training cloud established. Avoid conflating with AutoDL or IBM AutoAI.

watchlist.name: Baidu AI Cloud
watchlist.reason: Paid EasyDL training exists, including exports; same Baidu parent already covered by AI Studio. Retain product distinction without another vendor count.
